title: llm-usage-metrics tools report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for tools --json output: tool calls per tool, read from session files on disk.

data.description: Tool rows in the window, most calls first, and the totals over every call.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the date window.

since.description: First day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD); null for the full history.

until.description: Last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD); null when open-ended.

bySource.description: True with --by-source: rows are split by source.

byRepo.description: True with --by-repo: rows are split by project.

rows.description: Most calls first, then by tool name, source and project; at most --top rows.

totals.description: Every call in the window, including the rows --top leaves out.

errors.description: Calls whose result records an error.

unknown.description: Calls without a result in their file, or with a status the source does not map.

errorRate.description: errors over the calls with a known status (calls - unknown); null when none has one.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions that made at least one of the calls.

toolRow.description: One tool, or one tool per source or project with --by-source or --by-repo.

name.description: Tool name as the source logs it.

repoRoot.description: With --by-repo: the project key (repository root); null for sessions without one.

project.description: With --by-repo: the project label, as the projects report labels it.

topRepoRoot.description: The project key whose sessions made most of the calls; null for sessions without a repository root.

topProject.description: The label of topRepoRoot, as the projects report labels it.
